name: import_premiere_a1_a2_anglais_dpfc_2025_2026
query: WITH spec(chapter_title, chapter_order, lesson_title, lesson_order) AS (VALUES ($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 1 – TRAVEL AND WORLD TOURISM$$,10),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 2 – NATURAL RESOURCES$$,20),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 3 – DEADLY VIRUSES AND DISEASES$$,30),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 4 – CRIME AND VIOLENCE$$,40),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 5 – HUMAN RIGHTS$$,50),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 6 – TECHNOLOGY AND OUR LIVES$$,60),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 7 – POLITICAL CHANGE$$,70),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 8 – AFRICAN CULTURAL HERITAGE$$,80),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 9 – OUR CONSUMER SOCIETY$$,90),($$Progression annuelle 2025-2026$$,10,$$UNIT 10 – FRIENDS, DATING AND ENTERTAINMENT$$,100)), targets AS (SELECT o.id AS offering_id,o.subject_id,o.level_id,o.series_id FROM course_subject_offerings o JOIN levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN series s ON s.id=o.series_id JOIN subjects su ON su.id=o.subject_id WHERE l.name=$$Première$$ AND s.name IN ($$A1$$,$$A2$$) AND su.name=$$Anglais$$), inserted_chapters AS (INSERT INTO chapters(subject_offering_id,subject_id,level_id,series_id,title,description,display_order,is_active,is_test_data) SELECT t.offering_id,t.subject_id,t.level_id,t.series_id,s.chapter_title,NULL,s.chapter_order,false,false FROM targets t CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT chapter_title,chapter_order FROM spec) s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters c WHERE c.subject_offering_id=t.offering_id AND c.title=s.chapter_title) RETURNING id,subject_offering_id,title), chapter_targets AS (SELECT c.id,c.subject_offering_id,c.title FROM chapters c JOIN targets t ON t.offering_id=c.subject_offering_id UNION ALL SELECT id,subject_offering_id,title FROM inserted_chapters), inserted_lessons AS (INSERT INTO lessons(chapter_id,title,content,description,display_order,is_active,is_test_data) SELECT ct.id,s.lesson_title,NULL,NULL,s.lesson_order,false,false FROM chapter_targets ct JOIN spec s ON s.chapter_title=ct.title WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lessons le WHERE le.chapter_id=ct.id AND le.title=s.lesson_title) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_chapters) AS chapters_inserted,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_lessons) AS lessons_inserted;
